requirements.text: The position is based in the company’s office in San Francisco. All of the company’s engineers work in the office 5 days/week, and it seeks candidates who will be excited about working in a fast-paced, hard-working, high-performance environment where teammates are together in person.

Skyrocket Ventures is a recruiting firm for hundreds of high growth technology companies that range from industry leaders to top-tier startups. This opportunity is with one of our client companies for a full-time permanent hire. Please only apply if you are authorized to work in the U.S.
- A portfolio of interfaces you have designed and built, demonstrating your personal contribution, technical decisions, and attention to detail.
- Expertise in React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend development practices.
- Strong visual and interaction design judgment, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, and motion.
- The ability to explore ideas in Figma or code, explain your decisions, and work constructively through critique.
- Experience building production interfaces that handle real data, different screen sizes, accessibility needs, and edge cases.
- Demonstrated ability to own work independently from prototype through release, including testing and debugging code developed with AI tools.
- Interest in healthcare, wellness, or longevity.
- Experience at an early-stage startup or as a founding engineer.
